body: #8, #9, #10 and #11 each carry a supervised hold, so the operator ships them. Because #8 is SQUASH-merged, the stacked #9, #10 and #11 will conflict with main afterwards. As soon as #8 lands: rebase --onto origin/main <old #8 head 48a8dfa> product/story-79, then #10 onto the new #9 and #11 onto the new #10. Push with force-with-lease (full SHAs), retarget each to main, and mail the advisor the range-diff proofs. Approvals carry over only if the range-diff shows only '='. Don't touch the primary checkout.
subject: Prepare: after #8 squash-merges, restack #9 -> #10 -> #11 onto main
